paite: Huan; Pathianin Noa leh a tapate a vualjawla, a kiang uah chi tampi suang dingin hongpungin, lei luah dim un;
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

paite: Nou kihtakna leh launa leia sa chiteng leh tunga leng vasa chitengin a nei ding uh; huaite leh, leia khupboha pai tengteng leh tuipi ngasate tengteng na khut ua piak ahita uh;
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that the ground teems with, and all the fish of the sea are delivered into your hand.

paite: Thil hing tangthei chitengte noua dingin nek ding ahi ding ua; anteh hing kon piak bangin bangkim ka honpe vek hi;
english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As the green herb, I have given everything to you.

paite: Ahihhangin, sa a hinna, a sisan toh na ne khawm ding uh ahi kei;
english: But flesh with its life, its blood, you shall not eat.

paite: Huan, na sisan uh, na hinnate uh sisan phu, ka la ngei ngei ding; sa chiteng lakah ka la ding: mi lakah leng. Mi chih a unaute uh lakah, mi hinna phu ka la chiat ding;
english: I will surely require your blood of your lives. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

paite: Kuapeuh mi sisan suahmi mi mahin amah sisan a suah sam ding ahi: Pathian batpiha mi lah bawl ahi ngala.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

paite: Huan, nou chi tampi suangin hongpung un; leiah tampi nei unla, a tungah hongpung un, a chi hi.
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”

paite: Huan, Pathian, Noa kiang leh a kianga om a tate kiangah,
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

paite: Huan, ngai un, lei mahmahin na kiang uah leh nou nunga na suante kiang leng ka thukhun ka hihkip hi;
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

paite: Na kiang ua thil hing chiteng om, na ompih uh vasate, gante, na ompih uh leia sa chitengte kiangah leng; long akipana hong pawt tengteng, leia sa chiteng kiang nangawnah.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

paite: Huan, na kiang ua ka thukhun hihkip ding; sa tengteng leng tuichima hihmanin a omta kei ding uh; lei hihse dingin tuichim a tung nawn sam kei ding hi, chiin, a gen hi.
english: I will establish my covenant with you: all flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood, neither will there ever again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

paite: Huan, Pathian mahin, keileh nou leh na kiang ua thil hing chiteng omte kala, suan tawp neiloua om jel te dingin, hiai ka thukhun chiamtehna ahi ding:
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

paite: Meiah ka sakhituihup ka jamsaka, huai kei leh lei kala thukhun chiamtehna ding ahi ding.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be for a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

paite: Huan, hichi ahi dinga, leitunga mei ka kaisakin sakhituihup meiah a kimu ding,
english: It will happen, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

paite: Kei leh nou leh sa tengteng laka thilhing chitengte kala ka thukhun om ka theigige ding; huchiin, tui sa tengteng hihmang dingin a let nawnta kei ding.
english: and I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

paite: Huan, sakhituihup meiah a jam jel ding; huchiin, Pathian leh leitunga sa om tengteng laka thil hing chiteng kala khantawn thukhun om ka theihgige theihna dingin ka en jel ding, a chi a.
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

paite: Huan, Pathian mahin, Noa kiangah, huai kei leh leitunga sa om tengteng kala ka thukhun hihkip chiamtehna ahi, a chi nawn hi.
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

paite: Huan, Noa tapa long akipana pawtte Sem te, Ham te, Japheth te ahi uh: Ham Kanaan pa ahi.
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

paite: Huai mi thumte Noa tapate ahi uh: amaua kipana pawtten lei pumpi a jel suak uhi.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these, the whole earth was populated.

paite: Huan, Noa lounei miin a hong om pana, grep gui huan a bawla:
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

paite: Uain a dawna, a khama; huchiin a puanin ah a lum khialta hi.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

paite: Huan, Ham Kanaan pain, a pa lumkhial a mua, inpuaa a naute nih a hilha.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

paite: Huchiin, Sem leh Japhethin puan ala ua, lianga kijawnin a nungpai ua, a pa uh lumkhial a khuhta ua; a mai uh lehlam ngain a oma, a pa uh lumkhial a mu kei uhi.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

paite: Huan, Noa uain kham tuh a honghalha, a tapa naupangpenin a tunga ahihdan a hontheita hi.
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

paite: Huan, Kanaan hamsiatin omhen; a unaute sikhate sihka ahi ding, a chi hi.
english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be servant of servants to his brothers.”

paite: Toupa, Sem Pathian phatin omhen; Kanaan a sikha in om hen.
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

paite: Pathianin Japheth hihlian henla, huan, Kanaan a sikhain om hen, achi lai hi.
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

paite: Huan, Noa tuichim tun nungin kum za thum leh kum sawm nga a dam.Huchiin, Noa damsung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm nga ahi. Huan a sita hi.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

paite: Huchiin, Noa damsung tengteng kum za kua leh kum sawm nga ahi. Huan a sita hi.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, then he died.
